title: Test: Safety Enforcement
summary: Check what you learned across the whole chapter.

questions.q: The section **Refusing Proposals and Enforcing State Invariants** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: The feedback tracker guarantees a worst-case tracking tube only inside its qualified envelope, so the enforcer insets every clearance by it and watches the premises that keep it true.

A least-change projection passes a safe proposal untouched and projects a violating one onto the barrier boundary, keeping learned competence, while a structurally invalid proposal is vetoed rather than corrected.

The stopping envelope is the set of states from which the resident stop, after every worst-case delay, halts before the obstacle with localization, protective, and tracking margins intact, and its seven priced rows run as a per-tick speed governor.

The enforcement record joins a signed enforcement contract (tracking bound, barrier coefficients, deadlines, effort-error bounds, routing) to a per-tick admitted command with its margin, detector, and rung.
